messages.subject: For Dilhan Pillay | Sovereign investment, sustainability and geopolitical stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lin,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Dilhan Pillay, Chief Executive Officer.

Temasek's long-horizon investment approach increasingly requires disciplined understanding of sustainability, geopolitics, governments and operating realities across diverse markets. That intersection aligns strongly with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and work across operating, regulatory and sustainability priorities in an emerging-market environment.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support Temasek's portfolio or international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Temasek.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
